react.plan: My multi-cycle plan remains focused on gradual capital accumulation and knowledge building. This cycle, I will continue to maintain a defensive, cash-preserving position, limiting my trading activity to only a few low-risk spot trades. Next cycle, I may look for genuine technical setups that are not being heavily promoted, but for now, preserving my capital is the top priority.
